messages:
Mai: Quick sync on the vectors preview — I'm prototyping a compact toggle for dense result sets. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/wxyz9876/vector-preview-compact. Main concerns: keyboard discoverability and export UX for large selections. Lex: Compact mode looks good. Suggest collapsing metadata behind a chevron so primary text stays single-line. Move score pill inline with subtle divider. Sam: A11y: if rows go below 44px ensure checkboxes keep 32px tap targets by increasing hit area. Add `aria-describedby` to describe compact mode. Keyboard: support arrow/j/k nav, but include a `?` help modal to avoid surprises. Olivia: Selection clarity: show sticky selection counter "23 selected (visible)". If user picks "Select all results" show a persistent banner: "You selected 4,300 results — exports >500 will be queued." Mai: Banner copy: "Large export queued. We'll email you when it's ready. Streaming CSV for <=500 rows." Also require confirmation for exports >5,000 rows. Lex: Visual aid: show faint background bands for quartiles (top/median/bottom) using accessible colors. Sam: Export accessibility: announce queued exports with a polite live region and include a visually-hidden status for screen readers. Example: `
Export queued: we'll email you when ready.
`. Ensure focus returns after modal closes. Olivia: Export formats: CSV (default) and JSONL. Add checkbox "Include embeddings (base64)" with size warning. Provide a small schema link in modal. CSV header proposal: `id,text,score,dim,metadata`. JSONL example in modal. Mai: Dev note: need server-side queued export endpoint, job status endpoint, and streaming vs queued thresholds. Also lazy-load thumbnails and fetch metadata only on inspector open. design-bot: PR #512 opened with compact toggle + export modal changes. CI: accessibility-lint passed; failing e2e on selection persistence. https://github.com/redwood-inference/ui/pull/512 Lex: Action: I'll update Figma to show chevron collapse, condensed label, and quartile bands (ETA tomorrow). Sam: Action: I'll draft keyboard map, a11y snippets, and live region examples (ETA 48h). Olivia: Action: I'll draft export modal copy, add JSONL option, and sync with backend on streaming thresholds (ETA 2 days). Mai: Thanks — follow-up review next Tue. :thumbsup:
